rules.business_name: S23 Bull/Bull CF Call fresh-entry missed check and RC recalculation
rules.original_formula_or_text: E175 checks ORPT option LL against Call Sell Entry; M176/O176/T176/V176/X176 provide RC formulas

rules.business_name: S23 Bear/Bear CF Call fresh-entry missed RC recalculation

rules.business_name: S23 Put fresh-entry missed RC recalculation
rules.original_formula_or_text: Put rows contain LL wording in strike cells but user confirmed high-versus-high correction

rules.business_name: Carried position target protection and exit
rules.original_formula_or_text: Target protection active from market open; if target reached/crossed, book profit and exit.

rules.failure_behavior: no broker mutation; execution waits for future authority

rules.business_name: Carried Bull/Bull CF Call original SL not missed at ORPT

rules.business_name: Carried Bull/Bull CF Call original SL missed and revised FSL at RC

rules.original_formula_or_text: F190/Q190: Check If Close at 03:00:00 PM > Original SL; J190/U190: square off at CMP. F191/Q191: Check If Close at 03:00:00 PM < Original SL; J191/U191: continue position for next day and calculate stop loss price as per the rules. User clarified equality on 2026-07-31: close == original SL carries forward.
rules.normalized_formula: if 15:00 option close > original SL then SQUARE_OFF_AT_CMP_REQUIRED; if 15:00 option close <= original SL then CARRY_FORWARD_AND_CALCULATE_NEXT_DAY_SL
rules.failure_behavior: missing comparison evidence fails closed; next-day numeric SL comes from the verified row 183-188 carried-position rules, not from rows 190-191 themselves

rules.original_formula_or_text: S23 option-selling formulas use entry*(1-target%), entry/reference*(1+buffer%), and MIN bounded SL/MSL. The explicit negative-result guard was found only in S27 option-buying branches, not S23 option selling.
rules.normalized_formula: For valid positive option premium inputs, S23 option-selling target/SL/MSL/revised FSL outputs remain positive by construction. Invalid zero/negative market inputs have no S23 source-authorized placement behavior and fail closed.
rules.output: valid positive premium inputs keep S23 option-selling outputs positive; invalid market inputs fail closed
